en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined park or courtyard in front of a large, elegant multi‑storey building with tall windows and a steep tiled roof, typical of Central European architecture. In the foreground, behind an iron fence, stands a pedestal monument topped with a sculptural military helmet and perhaps a laurel wreath or shield. The pedestal bears inscribed panels of text in a serif script. The setting suggests a memorial in front of a public or institutional building, photographed in an early 20th‑century style.
